events.title: AHN Saint Vincent Festival of Trees
events.blurb: The 42nd annual holiday festival fills the convention center with decorated trees, with live reindeer from noon to 5 p.m.
events.blurbEs: El 42.º festival navideño anual llena el centro de convenciones de árboles decorados, con renos de verdad de mediodía a 5 p.m.

events.title: AHN Saint Vincent Festival After Dark
events.blurb: An adults-only evening at the Festival of Trees; general admission includes two drink tickets.
events.blurbEs: Una noche solo para adultos en el Festival of Trees; la entrada general incluye dos boletos para bebidas.

events.title: Erie Otters vs. Windsor Spitfires
events.blurb: OHL junior hockey as the Otters host the Windsor Spitfires.
events.blurbEs: Hockey juvenil de la OHL: los Otters reciben a los Windsor Spitfires.

events.title: Presque Isle Lights
events.blurb: A drive-through holiday light display in the park, running Fridays through Sundays, weather permitting. Park gates close at 9 p.m., but cars inside can stay until 10 p.m.
events.blurbEs: Un recorrido en auto por luces navideñas en el parque, de viernes a domingo si el clima lo permite. Los portones cierran a las 9 p.m., pero quienes ya estén dentro pueden quedarse hasta las 10 p.m.

events.title: Small Business Saturday (Miracle on State)
events.blurb: Local vendors set up at the Masonic Temple and the Erie Art Museum, and the Downtown Erie Community Skating Rink is open all day.
events.blurbEs: Vendedores locales se instalan en el Masonic Temple y el Erie Art Museum, y la Downtown Erie Community Skating Rink abre todo el día.

events.title: Handel's Messiah
events.blurb: The Erie Philharmonic performs Handel's Messiah, with general-admission seating.
events.blurbEs: La Erie Philharmonic interpreta el Messiah de Handel, con entrada general.

events.title: The Nutcracker
events.blurb: Erie Contemporary Ballet Theatre's annual holiday production of The Nutcracker.
events.blurbEs: La producción navideña anual de The Nutcracker de Erie Contemporary Ballet Theatre.

events.title: Selleena (No Cover)
events.blurb: Live music at BIGBAR downtown on Saturday night, with no cover charge.
events.blurbEs: Música en vivo en BIGBAR en el centro el sábado por la noche, sin cover.
